companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Companies to scrape reviews for. Give a bare domain ("monzo.com") or a full trustpilot.com/review/... URL - both are normalized to the domain automatically.

maxReviewsPerCompany.title: Max reviews per company
maxReviewsPerCompany.description: Maximum number of reviews to collect per company, newest first. The actor pages through results until it hits this limit or runs out of reviews.

includeCompanyInfo.title: Include company info
includeCompanyInfo.description: Also output one company record per domain with name, Trustpilot score, star rating, categories and total review count. These records are free and don't count toward usage.
